confirmDescriptions.send_confirmation: Diese sends die same confirmation nachricht as when die reservation was erstellt (bis die kunde e-Mail on datei).
confirmDescriptions.remind_3d: Sends die standard “3 tage before end” reminder vorlage.
confirmDescriptions.remind_1d: Sends die standard “1 day before end” reminder vorlage.
confirmDescriptions.remind_today: Sends die standard “ends heute” reminder vorlage.
confirmDescriptions.remind_remaining_days: Sends ein e-Mail stating how many whole calendar tage remain (UTC) until die reservation end datum.
confirmDescriptions.send_expired: Sends die notice that die reservation periode has ended (after die ablauf datum in UTC).
